classes.name: call event
classes.label: call event
classes.definition: an event associated with the call schedule for a debt instrument

classes.name: call feature
classes.label: call feature
classes.definition: redemption provision defining the rights of the issuer to buy back a security at a call price after a call protection period

classes.name: call notification provision
classes.label: call notification provision
classes.definition: provision of a call feature defining notification requirements

classes.name: call premium
classes.label: call premium
classes.definition: the price over par paid by an issuer to redeem securities when exercising a call provision

classes.name: call schedule
classes.label: call schedule
classes.definition: a schedule of call prices and when they are in effect

classes.name: call window
classes.label: call window
classes.definition: an explicit period of time prior to a call date during which an issuer or agent must give notice to holders

classes.name: debt offering
classes.label: debt offering
classes.definition: an offering of one or more debt instruments for sale

classes.name: fixed income security
classes.label: fixed income security
classes.definition: tradeable debt instrument that provides a return in the form of fixed periodic payments and typically the return of principal at maturity

classes.name: fully-indexed interest rate
classes.label: fully-indexed interest rate
classes.definition: a variable interest rate that is calculated by adding a margin to a specified index rate

classes.name: interest-only strip
classes.label: interest-only strip
classes.definition: a strip that represents the non-principal portion of the monthly payments on the underlying debt instrument, such as a bond

classes.name: issued debt
classes.label: issued debt
classes.definition: debt that is set out by the borrower in some form of financial security in which the lender is the holder or counterparty of that security

classes.name: make whole feature
classes.label: make whole feature
classes.definition: a call provision allowing the issuer to pay off remaining debt early

classes.name: margin
classes.label: margin
classes.definition: a variable that is added to a specified index rate to determine the fully indexed interest rate charged to a borrower on a credit balance

classes.name: non-tradable debt instrument
classes.label: non-tradable debt instrument
classes.definition: a debt instrument that may not be bought or sold

classes.name: notification provision
classes.label: notification provision
classes.definition: provision of a redemption feature defining notification requirements

classes.name: prescriptive event
classes.label: prescriptive event
classes.definition: event related to the imposition or enforcement of a rule, method, formula, etc.

classes.name: principal-only strip
classes.label: principal-only strip
classes.definition: a strip that represents the principal portion of the monthly payments on the underlying debt instrument, such as a bond

classes.name: publicly issued debt
classes.label: publicly issued debt
classes.definition: an issued debt in the form of a tradable debt instrument (security)

classes.name: put event
classes.label: put event
classes.definition: an event associated with the put schedule for a debt instrument, i.e., an event involving the 'put', or surrender of the instrument by the holder

classes.name: put feature
classes.label: put feature
classes.definition: redemption provision giving the holder the right, but not the obligation, to sell a specified amount of the debt instrument (i.e., redeem it), prior to maturity

classes.name: put notification provision
classes.label: put notification provision
classes.definition: a provision of a put feature defining notification requirements

classes.name: put premium
classes.label: put premium
classes.definition: an amount over par that a debt instrument holder must pay to sell the security early

classes.name: put schedule
classes.label: put schedule
classes.definition: a schedule that defines the events associated with the put feature of a debt instrument, i.e, the dates on which the debt instrument may be sold at what price by the holder

classes.name: put window
classes.label: put window
classes.definition: an explicit period of time prior to a put date during which holder or agent must give notice to an issuer

classes.name: redemption event
classes.label: redemption event
classes.definition: a prescriptive event involving the return of an investor's principal in a fixed-income security, such as a preferred stock or bond, or the sale of units in a mutual fund

classes.name: relative price
classes.label: relative price
classes.definition: security price specified in comparison with either a stated or market value for a debt instrument at some point in time

classes.name: step event
classes.label: step event
classes.definition: event that prescribes a change in a contractual term, such as a rate or notional amount, for a given contract

classes.name: step schedule
classes.label: step schedule
classes.definition: schedule specifying the date(s) and change in a contractual term(s), e.g., rate or notional amount, for a contract that has a feature where stipulated changes occur at specified intervals or on specified dates

classes.name: strip
classes.label: strip
classes.definition: a tradeable debt instrument created either through the process of removing coupons from a bond and then selling the separate parts as a zero coupon bond and an interest paying coupon bond or through taking the opposite position from some variant in the options market

classes.name: tradable debt instrument
classes.label: tradable debt instrument
classes.definition: a debt instrument that is also a security, i.e., that can be bought and sold by the holder

classes.name: variable income security
classes.label: variable income security
classes.definition: tradeable debt instrument that provide their owners with a rate of return that is dynamic and determined by market forces

edges.name: has call feature
edges.label: has call feature
edges.definition: indicates the specific terms related to any inherent call feature as specified in the offering/instrument

edges.name: has dated date
edges.label: has dated date
edges.definition: specifies the date on which interest begins to accrue on a fixed-income security

edges.name: has interest payment terms
edges.label: has interest payment terms
edges.definition: indicates the specific terms related to interest payments on the principal as specified in the instrument or a related contract document

edges.name: has notification provision
edges.label: has notification provision
edges.definition: relates the redemption provision of a debt instrument to a notification provision (e.g., call or put notification)

edges.name: has price and yield day count convention
edges.label: has price and yield day count convention
edges.definition: indicates the convention used to determine the number of days in a month and days in a year that are counted when performing calculations for yield and price figures

edges.name: has put feature
edges.label: has put feature
edges.definition: indicates the specific terms related to any inherent put feature as specified in the offering/instrument

edges.name: has relative price at issue
edges.label: has relative price at issue
edges.definition: indicates a relative price with respect to the face value at which an instrument is issued, namely par, premium or discount

edges.name: has relative price at maturity
edges.label: has relative price at maturity
edges.definition: indicates a relative price with respect to the face value at the time an instrument matures, namely par, discount or premium

edges.name: has relative price at redemption
edges.label: has relative price at redemption
edges.definition: indicates a relative price with respect to the face value at the time an instrument is redeemed, namely par, discount or premium

edges.name: has repayment terms
edges.label: has repayment terms
edges.definition: indicates the specific terms related to repayment of principal as specified in the instrument or a related contract document

edges.name: is subordinated to
edges.label: is subordinated to
edges.definition: indicates the target security (i.e., the one in the range) has a higher priority than the security in question

attributes.name: allows auto-reinvestment
attributes.label: allows auto-reinvestment
attributes.definition: indicates whether the security allows automatically re-investing the interest on that security towards purchasing additional shares or units of the same security

attributes.name: allows payment in kind
attributes.label: allows payment in kind
attributes.definition: indicates whether the principal may be repaid in kind (i.e., replaced with another instrument) rather than in cash

attributes.name: has default lot size
attributes.label: has default lot size
attributes.definition: indicates the default number of units of the security that may be held at any one time

attributes.name: has estate or death put feature
attributes.label: has estate or death put feature
attributes.definition: indicates that a security is subject to redemption upon the passing of the holder

attributes.name: has pool number
attributes.label: has pool number
attributes.definition: indicates the pool number of the debt

attributes.name: right to retain
attributes.label: right to retain
attributes.definition: indicates whether the holder has an option to retain the security in the event of an issuer exercising the put feature

attributes.name: is callable
attributes.label: is callable
attributes.definition: indicates whether the issuer (writer) of the debt contract (the debtor) can call the debt prior to maturity

attributes.name: is exchangeable
attributes.label: is exchangeable
attributes.definition: indicates whether the security can be exchanged for another security at the issuers discretion

attributes.name: is extendable by holder
attributes.label: is extendable by holder
attributes.definition: indicates whether the expiration date or maturity date can be extended by the holder

attributes.name: is extendable by issuer
attributes.label: is extendable by issuer
attributes.definition: indicates whether the issuer has the option to extend the debt rather than refinancing

attributes.name: is putable
attributes.label: is putable
attributes.definition: indicates whether the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity

attributes.name: is strippable
attributes.label: is strippable
attributes.definition: indicates whether or not the instrument can be stripped, so that interest and principal may be traded separately

attributes.name: is subordinated
attributes.label: is subordinated
attributes.definition: indicates whether the security is a subordinated security, meaning that the security has a lower priority than another security so that when the assets are liquidated this one is not first in line
